Name: (CP) Belted Galloway Cow Reskin
Author: RunoV
Description:
Simply replaces either brown or white cows with a Belted Galloway recolor of the vanilla cow sprite, and renames that type of cow as Belted Galloway (i.e. when you purchase one from Marnie or move one to a different barn.)  Also optionally changes the cow icon in Marnie's livestock shop to a Belted Galloway face.

[size=5]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5][font=Courier New]config.json[/font] options[/size]
[font=Courier New]config.json[/font] will appear in the [code][CP] Belted Galloway[/code] folder once you have run SMAPI with this mod installed at least once.

[code]ReplaceCowColor: Brown or White [defaults to Brown][/code] - determines which type of cow to replace
[code]ReplaceIcon: true or false [defaults to false][/code] - determines whether to replace the cow icon in Marnie's shop

[size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url] Installation[/size]

To use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url] instead of Content Patcher, just copy the [font=Courier New]belted_galloway.png[/font] and [font=Courier New]belted_galloway_baby.png[/font] files from [font=Courier New][CP] Belted Galloway/assets[/font] into [font=Courier New]AdoptSkin/assets/skins[/font] and rename them according to Adopt 'n' Skin's naming conventions. If you use this method, make sure the [font=Courier New][CP] Belted Galloway[/font] mod is not also installed.

This will not rename the cow type or replace the icon in Marnie's shop.
